title: Goodman salary and lessons
summary: Salary of two or three charts weekly allowed lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Yes. I had to do two or three a week.
And you were on salary; right?

Yes; and that was nice. Because of that I could now take lessons, which is what I wanted to do. There was always something beckoning, something beyond which I had. I still do that. That's part of the Judeo-Christian heritage. That's the way it is; I still keep looking for something that's not there, or that isn't immediately apparent and I felt illiterate, I didn't like the feeling and I wanted to do something about it, so I went to these various people.
